sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Today's special guest is Lord Blackwell, one of our country's most experienced and distinguished career diplomats.
sentences.translationZh: 今天的特邀嘉宾是布莱克威尔勋爵，我国最有经验、最杰出的职业外交官之一。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Welcome.
sentences.translationZh: 欢迎。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It's my pleasure.
sentences.translationZh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Our audience will be most interested in learning about a career in the foreign service.
sentences.translationZh: 我们的观众最感兴趣的是了解外交部门的职业生涯。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: However, before we talk about that, I'd like to ask you about the current developments hitting the news today regarding the Republic of Winopia.
sentences.translationZh: 然而，在我们谈论这个之前，我想问一下今天新闻中有关维诺皮亚共和国的最新进展。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: What can you tell us?
sentences.translationZh: 你能告诉我们什么？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I'm afraid I don't know much beyond what we've all seen on the news.
sentences.translationZh: 除了我们在新闻上看到的以外，恐怕我不知道太多。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It looks like the government of Winopia seems to be undergoing some sort of crisis of legitimacy and an interim administration has been transitionally established until a head of state is agreed on.
sentences.translationZh: 看起来维诺皮亚政府似乎正在经历某种合法性危机，临时政府已经过渡成立，直到就国家元首达成一致。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: But my career work has mostly focused around the Continental spheres of Europe and the Americas, and thus I've never been involved with Winopian relations.
sentences.translationZh: 但我的职业生涯主要集中在欧洲和美洲大陆领域，因此我从未参与过温诺普关系。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It's for this reason that I don't know anything on this matter beyond what we can all read in the newspapers.
sentences.translationZh: 正因如此，除了我们在报纸上读到的信息外，我对此事一无所知。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Oh, I see.
sentences.translationZh: 我懂了。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Nevertheless, be rest assured that our export envoys at our consulate there will be closely monitoring the situation and I expect our bilateral relations with that country will not be affected.
sentences.translationZh: 尽管如此，请放心，我们驻该国领事馆的出口特使将密切关注事态发展，我希望我们与该国的双边关系不会受到影响。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: So how does one get a career in foreign relations?
sentences.translationZh: 那么如何才能从事外交工作呢？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: There are many different paths one can take.
sentences.translationZh: 人们可以采取许多不同的路径。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: All diplomats have their own story.
sentences.translationZh: 所有外交官都有自己的故事。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: But in my case, I got a degree in electrical engineering followed by six years' service in the Air Force.
sentences.translationZh: 但就我而言，我获得了电气工程学位，随后在空军服役了六年。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Then I went to a law school and upon obtaining a degree in international law, I joined the diplomatic core where I've been for 22 years.
sentences.translationZh: 然后我去了法学院，获得国际法学位后，我加入了外交核心，在那里我已经工作了 22 年。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: What would you say are the key skills one needs for the job?
sentences.translationZh: 您认为这项工作所需的关键技能是什么？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: There are so many.
sentences.translationZh: 有这么多。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Being a hard worker and good student is important—you never stop learning.
sentences.translationZh: 努力工作和好学生很重要——你永远不会停止学习。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: In addition, a diplomat needs to be very articulate in their discourse and rhetoric.
sentences.translationZh: 此外，外交官的话语和言辞必须非常清晰。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Whether it is diffusing tension or enacting policy, people and communication skills are vital.
sentences.translationZh: 无论是缓解紧张局势还是制定政策，人员和沟通技巧都至关重要。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: It's getting late and we're both displaying signs of weariness.
sentences.translationZh: 天色已晚，我们都显露出疲倦的迹象。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I think we should call it a day and meet again tomorrow morning.
sentences.translationZh: 我想我们应该到此为止，明天早上再见面。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Oh, come on Jeff.
sentences.translationZh: 哦，来吧，杰夫。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: We are so close.
sentences.translationZh: 我们是如此接近。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Don't you think we're almost done?
sentences.translationZh: 你不觉得我们已经快完成了吗？

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Let's do two more hours, please.
sentences.translationZh: 请再做两个小时吧。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: One hour, then I'm going home.
sentences.translationZh: 一小时，然后我就回家了。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: OK, fine.
sentences.translationZh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: I think we are making good progress and that with a few more amendments we will be all done.
sentences.translationZh: 我认为我们正在取得良好进展，只要再进行一些修改，我们就会完成所有工作。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I'm sure looking forward to it.
sentences.translationZh: 我肯定很期待。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I'm so tired of this project.
sentences.translationZh: 我厌倦了这个项目。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Don't get me wrong—it's a great professional opportunity for me and a milestone for the company, but it's just been so long.
sentences.translationZh: 不要误会我的意思——这对我来说是一个很好的职业机会，也是公司的一个里程碑，但已经过去了太久了。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Yeah, two months working on nothing but the same contract is a little tough.
sentences.translationZh: 是的，两个月什么都没有做，但同一份合同有点艰难。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Nevertheless, I think that with a bit of luck we'll be done by next week.
sentences.translationZh: 尽管如此，我认为如果运气好的话，我们将在下周完成。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Ha!
sentences.translationZh: 哈!

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: You must be delusional.
sentences.translationZh: 你一定是产生了妄想。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You don't think so?
sentences.translationZh: 你不这么认为吗？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: No chance.
sentences.translationZh: 没有机会。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Sections four, five, eight and nine still have to be aligned in the new framework.
sentences.translationZh: 第四、五、八和九节仍需在新框架中保持一致。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Then we need to proofread the whole thing and make sure all selling points are watertight.
sentences.translationZh: 然后我们需要校对整个内容并确保所有卖点都是无懈可击的。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: But that will all take no more than a couple of days.
sentences.translationZh: 但这一切不会超过几天。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: I wasn't finished.
sentences.translationZh: 我还没说完。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: When we are done with it and send it upstairs, what do you think will happen?
sentences.translationZh: 当我们完成并把它送到楼上时，你认为会发生什么？

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: What?
sentences.translationZh: 什么？

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: They'll argue about it for like a month.
sentences.translationZh: 他们会为此争论一个月。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: There's always going to be the odd board member who intervenes and demands rectifications be made.
sentences.translationZh: 总会有一些奇怪的董事会成员介入并要求进行整改。

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: They might think they're being helpful but in reality they're being obstructive and hampering progress.
sentences.translationZh: 他们可能认为自己是有帮助的，但实际上他们是在阻碍并阻碍进步。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Oh Jeff, you're too preoccupied and cynical.
sentences.translationZh: 噢，杰夫，你太专注而且愤世嫉俗了。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: It won't be anywhere as bad as that.
sentences.translationZh: 不会有那么糟糕的地方。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: You'll see.
sentences.translationZh: 你会看到的。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: The entire managerial hierarchy wants to see this project implemented as soon as possible and the board too is virtually unanimous in its support.
sentences.translationZh: 整个管理层都希望看到这个项目尽快实施，董事会也几乎一致支持。

sentences.speaker: W
sentences.text: Go on then, let's stop there and meet up again, same time tomorrow.
sentences.translationZh: 那么继续吧，我们就到此为止，明天同一时间再见面。

They tried to ascertain the actual facts of the matter

sentences.text: One thing I’ve learned in a quarter century of management is that there are ample gray areas in human behavior and that there may not always be clear right-or-wrong solutions to employee disputes.
sentences.translationZh: 我在四分之一个世纪的管理生涯中学到的一件事是，人类行为中存在大量的灰色地带，并且对于员工纠纷可能并不总是有明确的正确或错误的解决方案。

sentences.text: When two people have different versions of the same event, it can be hard to know whom to believe.
sentences.translationZh: 当两个人对同一事件有不同的版本时，很难知道该相信谁。

sentences.text: One such circumstance always comes back to me.
sentences.translationZh: 我总是会想起这样一种情况。

sentences.text: It happened years ago and it’s a measure of the forgettable nature of the conflict that I no longer even recall what the dispute was about, but I definitely recall the resolution.
sentences.translationZh: 这件事发生在几年前，我什至不记得这场争端是关于什么的，但我绝对记得解决方案。

sentences.text: Two talented young executives, one of whom I was managing, had vastly different accounts of the same event and it seemed likely we’d never get to the truth.
sentences.translationZh: 两位才华横溢的年轻高管（其中一位是我所管理的）对同一事件的描述截然不同，我们似乎永远无法了解真相。

sentences.text: We reached the deadlock.
sentences.translationZh: 我们陷入了僵局。

sentences.text: And the manager of the other individual said, “Here’s something I learned from an excellent manager I once worked for.
sentences.translationZh: 另一个人的经理说：“这是我从我曾经工作过的一位优秀经理那里学到的东西。

sentences.text: He used to say, ‘when in doubt, assume positive intent.’” And just like that, we had a path forward.
sentences.translationZh: 他常说，‘当有疑问时，要抱有积极的意图。’”就这样，我们有了前进的道路。

sentences.text: My counterpart and I agreed we might never ascertain the actual facts of the matter.
sentences.translationZh: 我和我的对手一致认为，我们可能永远无法查明事情的真相。

sentences.text: Quite likely there were elements of truth in both employees' stories.
sentences.translationZh: 两名员工的故事中很可能都有真实的成分。

sentences.text: We agreed to monitor their actions and relationship going forward, but to intervene no further.
sentences.translationZh: 我们同意监控他们未来的行动和关系，但不再进行干预。

sentences.text: We assumed the best about both of them and moved on.
sentences.translationZh: 我们对他们俩都抱有最好的看法，然后继续前进。

sentences.text: The result was that we were able to put the conflict behind us.
sentences.translationZh: 结果是我们能够把冲突抛在脑后。

sentences.text: In fact, their problems didn't recur.
sentences.translationZh: 事实上，他们的问题并没有再次出现。

sentences.text: Over the years this general approach has proved useful.
sentences.translationZh: 多年来，这种通用方法已被证明是有用的。

sentences.text: Whenever the truth is obscure, assuming positive intent and agreeing to move on can be a constructive decision.
sentences.translationZh: 当真相模糊不清时，表现出积极的意图并同意继续前进可能是一个建设性的决定。

sentences.text: For some Americans, going out to dinner is a treat, planned and budgeted for.
sentences.translationZh: 对于一些美国人来说，出去吃饭是一种享受，是有计划和预算的。

sentences.text: For others, it's just a daily occurrence.
sentences.translationZh: 对于其他人来说，这只是每天都会发生的事情。

sentences.text: And that second group of people is becoming the majority, as the number of Americans who enjoy cooking is declining.
sentences.translationZh: 随着喜欢烹饪的美国人数量不断减少，第二类人正在成为大多数。

sentences.text: In the early 2000s, researcher Eddie Yoon conducted a survey to ascertain Americans' attitudes to cooking.
sentences.translationZh: 2000 年代初，研究员 Eddie Yoon 进行了一项调查，以确定美国人对烹饪的态度。

sentences.text: The survey found that $15\%$ of Americans loved to cook, $50\%$ said they hated to cook and $35\%$ reported mixed feelings.
sentences.translationZh: 调查发现，$15\%$ 的美国人喜欢做饭，$50\%$ 表示他们讨厌做饭，$35\%$ 则表示心情复杂。

sentences.text: When Yoon conducted the same survey 15 years later, only $10\%$ of respondents reported a love of cooking, $45\%$ said they hated it, and $45\%$ had mixed feelings.
sentences.translationZh: 15 年后，当 Yoon 进行同样的调查时，只有 $10\%$ 的受访者表示热爱烹饪，$45\%$ 表示讨厌烹饪，而 $45\%$ 则心情复杂。

sentences.text: Yoon asserts cooking is akin to sewing.
sentences.translationZh: 尹声称烹饪类似于缝纫。

sentences.text: As recently as the early 20th century, many Americans sewed their own clothing.
sentences.translationZh: 就在 20 世纪初，许多美国人还自己缝制衣服。

sentences.text: Today, the vast majority of Americans buy clothing; only a tiny minority still sew and they do it mainly as a hobby.
sentences.translationZh: 如今，绝大多数美国人购买服装；只有极少数人仍在缝纫，而且他们主要将其作为一种爱好。

sentences.text: Yoon believes the number of home cooks will diminish in a similar fashion.
sentences.translationZh: 尹相信家庭厨师的数量也会以类似的方式减少。

sentences.text: Currently, the average American household spends over $3,000 per year on dining out.
sentences.translationZh: 目前，美国家庭平均每年外出就餐花费超过 3,000 美元。

sentences.text: However, what people save in convenience, they lose in cash.
sentences.translationZh: 然而，人们在方便时省下的钱，却损失了现金。

sentences.text: Take buying lunch on work days, for example.
sentences.translationZh: 以工作日购买午餐为例。

sentences.text: People spend on average $10 per meal when they buy lunch.
sentences.translationZh: 人们购买午餐时平均每餐花费 10 美元。

sentences.text: Making your own lunch, meanwhile, will cost less.
sentences.translationZh: 同时，自己做午餐会花费更少。

sentences.text: One survey found people only spend on average $6.30 when they bring lunch prepared at home.
sentences.translationZh: 一项调查发现，人们携带在家准备的午餐时平均只花费 6.30 美元。

sentences.text: Americans' growing aversion to spending time in the kitchen signifies a host of challenges for the grocery industry.
sentences.translationZh: 美国人越来越不愿意花时间在厨房里，这意味着食品杂货行业面临着一系列挑战。

sentences.text: It's likely to detrimentally impact family finances as well.
sentences.translationZh: 这也可能对家庭财务产生不利影响。

sentences.text: Every year, of the more than 2.5 billion bags checked onto flights worldwide, 26 million go missing.
sentences.translationZh: 每年，全球航班托运的超过 25 亿件行李中，有 2600 万件失踪。

sentences.text: And of that 26 million, 1 million never make it back to their original owner.
sentences.translationZh: 而在这 2600 万之中，有 100 万再也没有回到原来的主人身边。

sentences.text: Bad weather and flight delays, miscoded destination tags, and some people simply forgetting to pick up one of their bags are a few of the reasons.
sentences.translationZh: 恶劣天气和航班延误、目的地标签编码错误以及有些人只是忘记领取其中一个行李都是其中一些原因。

sentences.text: But the number one reason a bag ends up lost is that it has no ID tag and airlines don't know to whom it belongs.
sentences.translationZh: 但行李最终丢失的首要原因是它没有身份标签，航空公司也不知道它属于谁。

sentences.text: Transferring baggage from check-in to departure gates to arrival gates to baggage claim is a delicate piece of timing.
sentences.translationZh: 将行李从登机口转移到登机口、到达口再到行李领取处是一个微妙的时机。

sentences.text: If the system moves too slowly, the bags won't make connecting flights.
sentences.translationZh: 如果系统移动太慢，行李将无法转机。

sentences.text: If it's too fast, the bags may make the connection, but the passengers might miss the flight.
sentences.translationZh: 如果速度太快，行李可能会转机，但乘客可能会错过航班。

sentences.text: Each airport has its own way of allotting how much time a bag needs to move in transit.
sentences.translationZh: 每个机场都有自己的方式来分配行李在运输过程中需要多长时间。

sentences.text: Some airports have sophisticated automated systems, including scanners that read baggage labels, destination coded vehicles that load and unload the bags without stopping, and sorting machines that route baggage to the appropriate gate.
sentences.translationZh: 一些机场拥有先进的自动化系统，包括读取行李标签的扫描仪、不间断装卸行李的目的地编码车辆，以及将行李运送到适当登机口的分拣机。

sentences.text: Even so, all that technology may not save your baggage tag from being torn off on the conveyor belt, making you the owner of a bag with no name.
sentences.translationZh: 即便如此，所有这些技术都可能无法避免您的行李标签在传送带上被撕下，从而使您成为一个没有名字的行李的主人。

sentences.text: Once a bag goes missing and the passenger files a claim, the bag is declared mishandled by the carrier.
sentences.translationZh: 一旦行李丢失并且乘客提出索赔，承运人就会宣布该行李处理不当。

sentences.text: Mishandled refers to bags that have been delayed, lost, stolen or damaged.
sentences.translationZh: 处理不当是指行李被延误、丢失、被盗或损坏。

sentences.text: Most delayed bags are only one flight behind their owners and can be delivered within 24 hours.
sentences.translationZh: 大多数延误的行李仅比其主人晚一趟航班，并且可以在 24 小时内送达。

sentences.text: The other bags are examined by airline employees for clues to their ownership and destination.
sentences.translationZh: 航空公司员工检查其他行李，寻找其所有权和目的地的线索。

sentences.text: If the mystery is solved, those bags are returned to their owners within four or five days.
sentences.translationZh: 如果谜团解开，这些袋子将在四五天内归还给它们的主人。

sentences.text: Bags with no destination code or identification tag are shipped to a central warehouse and undergo a comprehensive baggage tracing process over the next 90 days.
sentences.translationZh: 没有目的地代码或识别标签的行李将被运送到中央仓库，并在接下来的 90 天内接受全面的行李追踪流程。

sentences.text: Airlines inventory their mishandled baggage, and many use a database to match the contents with owners' descriptions.
sentences.translationZh: 航空公司会对处理不当的行李进行清点，许多航空公司使用数据库将内容与所有者的描述进行匹配。

sentences.text: It takes about three months to go from missing inaction to irretrievably lost.
sentences.translationZh: 从思念无所作为到无可挽回的迷失大约需要三个月的时间。

sentences.text: Once that happens, the bags are donated to charity, sold at auction, or purchased by a company which sells them to the public.
sentences.translationZh: 一旦发生这种情况，这些袋子就会被捐赠给慈善机构，在拍卖会上出售，或者由向公众出售它们的公司购买。

sentences.text: So never pack anything of real value in your checked baggage and make sure your name is on the bag along with your phone number so an agent can contact you.
sentences.translationZh: 因此，切勿在托运行李中装入任何真正有价值的物品，并确保行李上印有您的姓名和电话号码，以便工作人员与您联系。

sentences.text: You've probably been with someone who ignored you while interacting with his or her smartphone, and you've probably engaged in this behavior yourself.
sentences.translationZh: 您可能遇到过在与他或她的智能手机互动时忽略您的人，并且您自己也可能有这种行为。

sentences.text: In a recent survey, nine out of ten respondents said they'd used their smartphone during their most recent social activity.
sentences.translationZh: 在最近的一项调查中，十分之九的受访者表示他们在最近的社交活动中使用了智能手机。

sentences.text: There's also evidence that this behavior is socially harmful.
sentences.translationZh: 还有证据表明这种行为对社会有害。

sentences.text: It can leave people less satisfied with their face-to-face interactions, and it can generate feelings of resentment and jealousy.
sentences.translationZh: 它可能会让人们对面对面的互动不太满意，并可能产生怨恨和嫉妒的感觉。

sentences.text: Now, the Journal of Applied Social Psychology has published a new study exploring the reasons for these effects.
sentences.translationZh: 现在，《应用社会心理学杂志》发表了一项新研究，探讨了这些影响的原因。

sentences.text: The study included 128 mostly female student participants.
sentences.translationZh: 该研究包括 128 名参与者，其中大部分是女性。

sentences.text: The participants watched a three-minute animation in which two cartoon figures interacted and engaged in a conversation.
sentences.translationZh: 参与者观看了一段三分钟的动画，其中两个卡通人物互动并进行对话。

sentences.text: The conversation couldn't be heard, but could be detected through mouth movements.
sentences.translationZh: 谈话内容听不到，但可以通过嘴巴的动作察觉到。

sentences.text: Participants had to imagine themselves as the closest figure in the video, and then make judgments about the conversations and how they felt about their conversation partners.
sentences.translationZh: 参与者必须将自己想象成视频中最接近的人物，然后对对话以及他们对对话伙伴的感受做出判断。

sentences.text: In one version of the experiment, the phone of the participant's conversation partner remained unused on the table throughout the conversation.
sentences.translationZh: 在实验的一个版本中，参与者的对话伙伴的电话在整个对话过程中一直放在桌子上未使用。

sentences.text: In another version, their partner's attention was quickly drawn to something on their phone, and they spent the rest of the time interacting with their phone.
sentences.translationZh: 在另一个版本中，他们的伴侣的注意力很快就被手机上的某些东西吸引，他们把剩下的时间都花在了与手机互动上。

sentences.text: A third version involved the participant's partner alternating between periods of interaction with their phone and periods where they ignored their phone.
sentences.translationZh: 第三个版本涉及参与者的伴侣在与手机互动的时期和忽略手机的时期之间交替。

sentences.text: If you've experienced the similar situation, you probably won't be surprised by the results of the experiments.
sentences.translationZh: 如果您经历过类似的情况，您可能不会对实验结果感到惊讶。

sentences.text: The participants had a negative view of phone use during social interactions.
sentences.translationZh: 参与者对社交互动中使用手机持负面看法。

sentences.text: The more it was present, the worse they considered both the quality of the interaction and the quality of the relationship.
sentences.translationZh: 它出现的越多，他们认为互动的质量和关系的质量就越差。

sentences.text: The researchers believed that focusing on one's phone instead of the person one is with has this effect because it's seen as a form of social exclusion.
sentences.translationZh: 研究人员认为，专注于手机而不是身边的人会产生这种效果，因为这被视为一种社会排斥形式。

sentences.text: They assert that the behavior is analogous to when people have no choice but to eat alone in the school cafeteria.
sentences.translationZh: 他们声称这种行为类似于人们别无选择只能在学校食堂独自吃饭。

sentences.text: The twist is that this exclusion occurs while sharing a physical encounter and having a conversation.
sentences.translationZh: 奇怪的是，这种排斥发生在分享身体接触和交谈时。

sentences.text: Researchers found that the behavior had adverse effects on participants' sense of belonging, need for meaning and self-esteem.
sentences.translationZh: 研究人员发现，这种行为会对参与者的归属感、意义需求和自尊产生不利影响。

sentences.text: These negative effects are similar to those caused by traditional forms of social exclusion.
sentences.translationZh: 这些负面影响与传统形式的社会排斥造成的负面影响类似。

sentences.text: The new findings are important because they elaborate our understanding of a subtle but common aspect of our daily experience.
sentences.translationZh: 新发现很重要，因为它们阐述了我们对日常经历中微妙但常见的方面的理解。

sentences.text: This common behavior can create vicious cycles of detachment even as we try to connect with others.
sentences.translationZh: 即使我们试图与他人建立联系，这种常见的行为也会造成疏离的恶性循环。

sentences.text: More and more people travel for a variety of reasons.
sentences.translationZh: 越来越多的人出于各种原因出行。

sentences.text: Many are tourists, but many venture for some personal or professional business.
sentences.translationZh: 许多人是游客，但许多人冒险从事一些个人或专业业务。

sentences.text: Whatever the reason for traveling, a common complaint of travelers is the impersonal accommodations they find.
sentences.translationZh: 无论旅行的原因是什么，旅行者普遍抱怨的就是他们发现的住宿条件不人性化。

sentences.text: After spending five consecutive nights in five similar hotels, the business traveler may find it difficult to remember what happened from day to day or even what towns were visited.
sentences.translationZh: 在五家类似的酒店连续住了五晚后，商务旅行者可能会发现很难记住每天发生的事情，甚至很难记住访问过哪些城镇。

sentences.text: And the tourists may get the mistaken impression that all cities are pretty much the same, at least as far as decoration, food and service are concerned.
sentences.translationZh: 游客可能会误以为所有城市都差不多，至少在装饰、食物和服务方面是如此。

sentences.text: To combat this sense of impersonal sameness, travelers are taking advantage of in-home hospitality or bed-and-breakfast arrangements.
sentences.translationZh: 为了消除这种非个人化的千篇一律的感觉，旅行者正在利用家庭招待或住宿加早餐的安排。

sentences.text: B&Bs, I mean, bed-and-breakfast arrangements, are private homes which offer lodging and breakfast in a very personalized friendly setting.
sentences.translationZh: B&B，我的意思是，住宿加早餐安排，是私人住宅，在非常个性化的友好环境中提供住宿和早餐。

sentences.text: For decades, B&Bs have been the classic way to visit Europe, especially the British Isles.
sentences.translationZh: 几十年来，住宿加早餐旅馆一直是游览欧洲（尤其是不列颠群岛）的经典方式。

sentences.text: And in fact, they are not really a new idea in America.
sentences.translationZh: 事实上，它们在美国并不是什么新想法。

sentences.text: The tradition dates back to colonial times when inns were few and far between, and the weary traveler had to depend on the kindness of strangers for a meal and a bed.
sentences.translationZh: 这一传统可以追溯到殖民时期，当时旅馆很少，而且距离很远，疲惫的旅行者不得不依靠陌生人的好意来获得食物和床铺。

sentences.text: But the revival of B&Bs as desirable accommodations is a fairly recent phenomenon.
sentences.translationZh: 但民宿重新成为理想的住宿场所是最近才出现的现象。

sentences.text: If the idea of operating a B&B arouses your interest, there are several factors to consider before plunging into this business.
sentences.translationZh: 如果经营民宿的想法引起了您的兴趣，那么在投入这项业务之前需要考虑几个因素。

sentences.text: The first consideration is your property, not only the building itself, but the location.
sentences.translationZh: 首先要考虑的是您的财产，不仅是建筑物本身，还有位置。

sentences.text: If you live near a famous historical site or in a popular destination such as New York City or Washington D.C., your home can be fairly simple yet still do well as a B&B.
sentences.translationZh: 如果您住在著名的历史遗址附近或纽约市或华盛顿特区等热门目的地，您的家可以相当简单，但作为住宿加早餐酒店仍然很不错。

sentences.text: On the other hand, if your home is architecturally unique or has facilities for the traveler such as a private entrance, private bath or swimming pool, people may be willing to go some distance to reach you.
sentences.translationZh: 另一方面，如果您的家具有独特的建筑风格或为旅行者提供设施，例如私人入口、私人浴室或游泳池，那么人们可能愿意走一段距离才能到达您。

sentences.text: Another important factor is the lifestyle of you and your family.
sentences.translationZh: 另一个重要因素是您和您家人的生活方式。

sentences.text: You must take into account whether all members of the family truly enjoy visitors, want to repeatedly discuss local sites and activities, and have the time and energy to handle the additional cooking, cleaning, laundry and the book keeping involved.
sentences.translationZh: 您必须考虑所有家庭成员是否真正喜欢游客，想要反复讨论当地景点和活动，并有时间和精力处理额外的烹饪、清洁、洗衣和簿记工作。

sentences.text: The final consideration is a financial one.
sentences.translationZh: 最后的考虑是财务方面的。

sentences.text: Potential B&B hosts must be realistic about opportunities for income.
sentences.translationZh: 潜在的民宿主人必须对收入机会持现实态度。

sentences.text: While B&Bs usually have low initial costs, experts estimate it would take at least five rooms rented regularly for the host to earn a living from B&B.
sentences.translationZh: 虽然民宿的初始成本通常较低，但专家估计，主人至少需要定期租用五个房间才能靠民宿谋生。
